arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/how-it-works.md'; s=open(p).read()
old="The hook does nothing when the message already contains `#<number>`, or for merge, amend, and other commits with a commit source |"
new="The hook does nothing when the message already contains `#<number>`, or when git gives a commit source. Git gives a commit source for `git commit -m` and `-F`, templates, merges, squashes, and amends. Thus, the hook adds the reference only when git opens an editor for the message |"
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
